name: india
title: Indian formats (₹, mobiles, PAN, GSTIN, IFSC, UPI)
summary: One shared module for Indian mobile normalisation, rupee formatting (lakh/crore), and PAN/GSTIN/IFSC/PIN/UPI validation, usable from the browser and api/.
when: The site serves Indian visitors: prices in rupees, mobile numbers, invoices, donations (80G/PAN), vendor sign-ups (GSTIN/IFSC).
next: Import from @/lib/india in the browser and from '../src/lib/india' in api/ routes: one copy of every rule.
